review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C input. OPT-1 is explicitly fixed as a hypothetical benchmark assumption, not a human Decision; the empty human-decision input is therefore consistent, while a material unresolved DEC-001 must still block paired B at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, task keys, evidence stages, and ready status align with the PRD. The writable scope covers message formatting, public/internal option declarations, runtime normalization, option filtering, and regression/type tests. Existing forwarding and declaration consumers appropriately remain inspection owners; build configuration supports generated distribution declarations rather than separately maintained declaration owners. TASK-VERIFY remains independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with both tasks covering every required AC. The supplied original-project scoped active claims, role memberships, and availability support the specified eligible agents without relying on Persona, pending claims, or creating new attestations. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree. Supplied provenance distinguishes original/saved PRD, manifest/evaluation-source, and unbundled Service/executing-bundle fingerprint domains, resolving the previous review's runner-identity ambiguity. Model identity, policy identity/version, sampling fingerprint, and budgets are consistently frozen. This approval concerns planning expectations only, not execution readiness or successful tests. I reviewed only the supplied evidence, ran no tools or code, and did not independently recompute digests or attest human confirmation.
